claims.text: The graph-based features include Coreness, Strength, Eccentricity, Closeness, and Reciprocity.
Coreness and Strength help detect changes in the direct neighborhood of the targeted author.
Eccentricity reflects changes in interactions around the targeted author.
Closeness measures average node centrality in the graph.
Reciprocity indicates the general reciprocity of exchanges between users.
